Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Brighton Quantum's use case and priorities. I wanted to capture the key points and proposed next steps so we can stay aligned: 

Recap (from our call)
- Primary goal: reduce per-inference cost on customer-facing features while keeping 95th percentile latency under 200ms.
- Workloads: short chat queries (~64 tokens), occasional long context for diagnostics (~2-3k tokens).
- Data sensitivity: model inputs include customer PII; need audit logs and KMS integration.
- Current infra: internal GPU cluster + API wrapper, struggling with autoscaling and cold starts.

What Redwood can do (high-level)
- Dedicated pools for predictable throughput and latency SLOs.
- Prefix/KV caching to reduce per-token spend for common queries.
- Private deployment options with KMS + audit logs to meet compliance needs.

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll share a short discovery recap doc and a rough pricing brief (attached).
2) If this looks promising, schedule a technical deep-dive with Dylan (our platform architect) to review integration and SLOs — 60 minutes.
3) Discuss procurement cadence and any security questionnaires your team needs us to fill.

Attachments: brightonq-discovery-recap.pdf (summary), redwood-pricing-brief.xlsx (ballpark pricing)

Would you be open to the technical deep-dive next week? I can send a few times.

Thanks,
Marissa
